rule_sources: ADR0025 Kubernetes/Kustomize, Compose, Crossplane, node identity, references, paths
derivation: Only retained immutable source trees/files, YAML source scalar locations, manually selected finite unit table, and approved format rules. No product output, evaluator, fixture implementation, mutation or auditor material.

comparison_contract.nodes: Compare the entire multiset keyed by repository,file,address,root, including unknown/uncontracted kinds. Public export cannot prove node completeness.
comparison_contract.references: Compare whole endpoint/via-source-field groups and both reverse directions. Source native field names are the key; equivalent rendered via wording is acceptable only when it names the same source site.
comparison_contract.traces: For every source-selected reference-bearing node, save full up/down traces, verify complete local reference reachability, and preserve same-scope stdio/HTTP byte equality. Contract traversal is judged separately by its accepted source keys.
comparison_contract.privacy: Generic node keys expose only names/locations; secret config values follow ADR0025 and remain absent from export.
